notes:
v1.5.1 Release:
- Dub Whole Series no longer stops at Isolate BGM when Spleeter and Demucs are not installed: it uses FFmpeg and says so in the step
- New workspace: tools on a rail at the left, subtitles and timeline in the middle, and a full-height preview. Sky-blue is the new default theme; Fresh Mint and Classic Indigo are still in the presets
- Blur Subtitles: finds the subtitles already burned into a video and blurs them in the export
- Transcribe keeps retrying for up to 30 minutes when Google is busy instead of failing the tab, and finished parts are reused after a restart
- Voice pickers now offer just Male and Female
- Fixed blank animated icons, play and pause icons showing at once, and the invisible Auto-Ducking switch
- Dub Whole Series: new Hands-free option exports each part and starts the next part by itself
- Series keeps character names the same across parts and uses the Drama Style you pick (modern dramas no longer get royal court words)
- Voices start on time: the silence added before and after each voice clip is trimmed, so fewer lines are sped up or shortened
- Exported subtitles match the preview: size, colour, bold/italic/underline and position, and long Khmer lines break between words
- Exports have the same loudness, so parts don't jump in volume
- Background music isolation is remembered for files already done, and you are told when an engine fails instead of getting music-less tabs
- Gemini: busy models and daily limits no longer use up every key, transcription moves to another model when one is busy or out for the day, and keys added during a run are used
- Better Khmer translations: the right forms of address, and line length that fits the time
- Preview: a voice line no longer replays its first word at the end
- Security: the app's window and local server are locked down, and the app now runs on Electron 44
